name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.5 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Antenna Flow stability release with the new Collection Manager. v0.22.5 keeps the v0.22.4 clean shell, fast Home, Tonight, deterministic Velvet Lens and CC+ subtitle search, then adds a permission-aware MANAGE COLLECTION action on Jellyfin BoxSet detail pages. The manager shows current Movies, Series and nested BoxSets, removes collection membership without deleting media, searches the whole Jellyfin library for Movies or Series to add, and provides a clearly-labelled Likely Missing view for matching titles already present in the library but not yet members of the collection. It does not pretend to know internet-wide franchise completeness without an external catalogue source.
